# Seconds per package, used by ci-rshard-packages.sh to balance the default (r0..r3) test shards.
# Source: the per-package times `go test` printed in CI runs 42130407689 (PR #1485) and 42142145838
# (PR #1486), shards r0..r3, mean of the two runs (the one run for a package that was cached in the
# other), rounded up to whole seconds, packages that took 20 s or more. They are times under load (many
# packages run in parallel on one runner), so only the relative sizes matter. A package missing from
# this file (new, or fast) weighs 5. Refresh occasionally: nothing breaks if it goes stale, the split just drifts.
